meta.title: We Accidentally Took Vietnam’s Most Scenic Train - The Heritage Train From Hue to Danang
meta.description:
Is the Heritage Train between Hue and Da Nang actually the most scenic rail journey in the world, or just a well-marketed tourist trap? We spent 3.5 hours on the tracks to find out.

In this video, we're sharing our first-hand experience and an honest review of the Heritage Train through the famous Hai Van Pass. If you’re planning a trip through Central Vietnam, there are things you need to know before you book your ticket.

What We Cover:
1:05 Booking the Heritage Train - Best App
2:08 Inside the Train Car - Comfort and Amenities
2:45 The Views and Scenery - How to Best Enjoy
4:05 The Community Car Tour
4:33 Lang Co Station Stop
5:06 Our Final Thoughts and Recommendations

We are Andrea & Keith - early retirees who are travelling the world without flying, focusing on slow travel, and finding the most authentic ways to get from A to B. If you love straight-talk reviews and seeing the world from the ground up, consider subscribing to join the journey!
